title: Distributed Raman amplification in G.652 standard single-mode fiber
model: Pump-signal coupled equations with depletion, Equations (10)-(11); undepleted closed form, Equation (12)
reference_plane: span input and span output (fiber only; WDM coupler and connector losses not included)
notes: The gain efficiency C_R is the quantity that enters the model; g_R and A_eff are stored separately only to document its derivation. The measured SSMF Raman profile used for multi-pump design is stored in data/raman_ssmf_gnpy.csv.

L.applies_to: span length of the cross-validation case

gR_1um.applies_to: peak Raman gain coefficient of silica for a 1 um pump

gR.derivation: g_R(1 um) scaled with 1/lambda_p to 1450 nm
gR.applies_to: peak g_R for a 1450 nm pump

Aeff.applies_to: G.652 fiber of the SMF-28 class, 1450-1550 nm

alpha_s.applies_to: cabled attenuation at 1550 nm (fiber specification <= 0.18 dB/km)

alpha_p.applies_to: attenuation at 1450 nm, between the 1383 nm (<= 0.32) and 1490 nm (<= 0.21 dB/km) specifications

C_R.applies_to: peak Raman gain efficiency, 1450 nm pump

verification.consistency: within 3 % of the measured SSMF profile in GNPy (0.4195 1/(W km) at 12.75 THz for a 1454 nm pump)
